prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: desktop web app redesign composition comp, 1440x900 landscape
Primary request: Create a high-fidelity UI composition mockup for the Korean elementary literacy app “관점 렌즈 사건실” (Perspective Lens Case Room). Show the learning mechanism at work: two narrator voices describing one fictional event, a learner separating observation/inference/evaluation evidence, comparing viewpoints, then preparing a rewrite. This is a designed application screen, not a poster or illustration.
Structure/composition: editorial stage-cue layout. A calm top bar with the product name and a compact six-step progress rail; below, a wide split reading stage with narrator A and narrator B on opposite sides of a thin central comparison rail; a lower evidence tray contains three labeled evidence categories and one clear next-action button. Use real Korean UI labels where readable: “관점 렌즈 사건실”, “사건 접수”, “렌즈 A/B”, “근거 보드”, “교차 조사”, “관점 전환”, “사건 보고서”, “관찰 사실”, “인물의 추론”, “평가 표현”. Keep the learner task obvious within the first viewport.
Identity reference: use the attached existing screenshot only for its light paper surface, dark ink typography, teal/orange accents, compact card character, and accessible contrast. Do not copy its exact content, layout, or text placement.
Style/material: paper editorial worksheet, ink rules, one teal action color and one orange annotation color, no gradients, no dark mode, no glossy glass, no emoji icons, no stock photos, no invented logos, no decorative hero illustration.
Interaction cues: selected evidence has a clear outline and text label; the one primary next-action button has a subtle static emphasis; show safe keyboard focus ring on one control. Keep controls semantic and compact.
Quality: polished production UI mockup, crisp typography, readable hierarchy, generous margins, realistic responsive web layout. Avoid: poster-only composition, fake marketing claims, excessive rounded cards, generic SaaS dashboard, purple/blue AI gradients, tiny unreadable text, watermarks.
